user.title: Address Book
user.description: Add an address book to Home Assistant. Everything you enter is stored locally on this system.

data_description.days_ahead: The address_book_reminder event fires this many days before a date, and again on the day itself. 0 means only on the day.
data_description.reminder_time: When the address_book_reminder event fires each day.

set_person.name: Add or change a person
set_person.description: Adds a new person when no ID is given and returns its ID. With an ID, changes only the fields that are given.

id.name: ID
id.description: The person to change. Leave empty to add a new one.

gender.name: Gender
gender.description: Only picks a word, such as uncle or aunt.

birth_date.name: Date of birth
birth_date.description: Written as 1980-05-17, --05-17 (year unknown) or 1980 (only the year). Empty clears it.

death_date.name: Date of death
death_date.description: Written as 1980-05-17, --05-17 (year unknown) or 1980 (only the year). Empty clears it.

deceased.name: Deceased
deceased.description: For someone who has died on an unknown date.

emails.name: Email addresses
emails.description: A list of items with a value and an optional label. Replaces the existing list.

phones.name: Phone numbers
phones.description: A list of items with a value and an optional label. Replaces the existing list.

household_id.name: Household
household_id.description: The ID of the household where this person lives. Empty removes the person from the household.

group_ids.name: Groups
group_ids.description: A list of group IDs. Replaces the existing list.

send_birthday_card.name: Send a birthday card
send_birthday_card.description: Whether this person gets a birthday card.

set_household.name: Add or change a household
set_household.description: Adds a new household when no ID is given and returns its ID. With an ID, changes only the fields that are given.

id.name: ID
id.description: The household to change. Leave empty to add a new one.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional label; derived from the members when empty.

house_number_addition.name: House number addition
house_number_addition.description: Written after the house number with a hyphen: 2-A.

street2.name: Second address line
street2.description: An extra line, when the address needs one.

address_verified_on.name: Address verified on
address_verified_on.description: The date someone last confirmed this address, as 2026-11-01. Empty clears it.

send_seasonal_card.name: Send a seasonal card
send_seasonal_card.description: Whether this household gets a seasonal card.

set_group.name: Add or change a group
set_group.description: Adds a new group when no ID is given and returns its ID. With an ID, changes only the fields that are given.

id.name: ID
id.description: The group to change. Leave empty to add a new one.

set_relationship.name: Add or change a relationship
set_relationship.description: Adds a new relationship when no ID is given and returns its ID. With an ID, changes only the fields that are given.

id.name: ID
id.description: The relationship to change. Leave empty to add a new one.

type.name: Type
type.description: Required for a new relationship. Only parent, spouse and partner feed the family tree.

from_id.name: From
from_id.description: The ID of the first person. For parent and godparent: the parent or godparent.

to_id.name: To
to_id.description: The ID of the second person. For parent and godparent: the child.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: For spouse: the wedding date. Written as 1980-05-17, --05-17 (year unknown) or 1980 (only the year). Empty clears it.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Written as 1980-05-17, --05-17 (year unknown) or 1980 (only the year). Empty clears it.

ended.name: Ended
ended.description: Divorced or separated. A death does not end a relationship.

label.name: Label
label.description: Free text, used with type other.

set_event.name: Add or change an event
set_event.description: Adds a new event when no ID is given and returns its ID. With an ID, changes only the fields that are given.

id.name: ID
id.description: The event to change. Leave empty to add a new one.

date.name: Date
date.description: Required for a new event. A yearly event needs at least a month and day (--06-21); a one-off event needs a full date.

yearly.name: Yearly
yearly.description: Whether the event returns every year. On by default.

person_ids.name: People
person_ids.description: A list of the IDs of the people involved. Replaces the existing list.

remove_person.name: Remove a person
remove_person.description: Removes a person together with their relationships.

remove_household.name: Remove a household
remove_household.description: Removes a household. Its members stay, without an address.

remove_group.name: Remove a group
remove_group.description: Removes a group. Its members stay.

remove_relationship.name: Remove a relationship
remove_relationship.description: Removes a relationship between two people.

find_people.name: Find people
find_people.description: Returns the people whose name or nickname contains every word of the search text, with their IDs.

query.name: Search text
query.description: One or more words, in any order.

import_calendar.name: Import a birthday calendar
import_calendar.description: Turns a calendar into people and households: the title is the name, the location the address on one line, the description a note. Only day and month are taken over, never a year. A title with several names becomes those people and a yearly event. What is already there is skipped. The calendar itself is not changed.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: On by default: returns what would be added without changing anything. Turn off to import.
